ui.secureYourHardEarnedFunds: Secure your hard-earned funds in the Imperial Credit Vault. All deposits accumulate weekly compounding interest safely, growing your portfolio automatically while shielded from danger.
ui.guildApprovedLoansProvideEmergency: Guild-approved loans provide emergency funding directly from imperial reserves. Keep track of maturity terms: overdue balances trigger doubled penalty premium rates.
ui.unresolvedDebtsDirectlyImpactCredit: Unresolved debts directly impact credit status.
ui.authorizeTheTransferOfHoldings: Authorize the transfer of holdings into the secure vault to yield interest.
ui.submitAPetitionToRelease: Submit a petition to release holdings from the secure vault to your person.
ui.petitionForAStandardDebt: Petition for a standard debt advance. Overdue balances trigger doubled penalty premium interest.
ui.transferPersonalCoinToRetire: Transfer personal coin to retire outstanding liabilities recorded against your score.
ui.welcomeToTheImperialVault: Welcome to the Imperial Vault of Credit. In this sacred registry, guild members may securely deposit their lawfully earned holdings, shielding them from the perils of deployment, and yielding compounding interest returns every cycle.
ui.allDebtsNotRetiredWithin: All debts not retired within the standard maturity term accrue premium interest penalties.
ui.standardDepositYieldsDynamicallyRespond: Standard deposit yields dynamically respond to regional market updates.
ui.selectTheDesiredTabAbove: Select the desired tab above to manage your deposits, request loans, or view outstanding debt deeds.
ui.selectTheDesiredFinancialAction: Select the desired financial action in the left account pockets and apply your signature wax seal on the application deed to execute.
